verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers some natural-language entry points. MCP-capable agents such as Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT can connect through Airbyte Agents to query, search and act on data, and an AI Assistant prefills Connector Builder configuration. None of this evidence shows natural-language commands operating the platform itself, such as creating connections, triggering syncs or changing schedules. missing for 10: documented natural-language control of core platform operations (connections, syncs, schedules), detail on which actions the MCP server exposes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
